title: Morning Brief
summary: Haskap's general product page could launch this weekend with angle presales early next week; kidney health and joint pain are still being weighed. Retention work centres on better cancellation saves while keeping payment and post-purchase features. Growth planning targets a December and January acceleration toward a long-term $10 million a month.
points: AVIA priorities: the masterclass, a new offer and Haskap pages
Packaging, seasonal gifts, separate SKUs, FAQs and QR-linked welcome guides for customer education
Strategy: recognisable brands, substantiated claims, distinct formats and multi-channel distribution
The coaching platform still needs integrations, security, reliable data and course hosting
Hiring: creative leadership, operations delegation, backup media buying and creative strategists
MAIA's Amazon listing has conflicting claims that need an urgent review
decisions: Launch the Haskap general page first, presales after
Add a Black Friday banner on the store
Hire a backup media buyer and a landing page specialist

tasksImported.title: Revise the Haskap product page copy and write its FAQ

Add the Black Friday top banner and send Elissa the banner request

Fix the weekly cash flow forecast update
Talk to Sarvin about packaging and ERP
